$comment: The LLM router's price table (DGO-1893): USD per million tokens, as each provider bills Bina. A call costs (uncached input × in + cached input × cached + cache writes × write + output × out) / 1e6 USD, × usd_ils, × (1 + margin), in agorot rounded up. A model not listed here is refused, never served unpriced. The admin screen edits usd_ils and margin at run time; a model's prices change here, in a commit. Sources: Claude — the claude-api skill's model table (cached 2026-10-06); DeepSeek and OpenAI — the providers' public price pages as last read (UNCONFIRMED for 2026-11: check before launch, and on every provider price change).
